newsitem.title: EGYPT: East Delta Flour Mills profits up in Q1.
newsitem.headline: East Delta Flour Mills profits up in Q1.

text.p: East Delta Flour Mills made pre-tax profits of 9.7 million pounds in the first quarter of the financial year 1996/97, up from 6.2 million in the same period the previous year, the specialist weekly al-Boursa said on Monday.
The financial years end on June 30.
Audited net profits for the whole of 1995/96 reached 27.78 million pounds compared with 27.62 million in 1994/95.
The firm expected to add some four million pounds to its net profits with the completion of expansion projects by mid-1997, al-Boursa said.
Sales rose to 389.63 million pounds in July-September on 352.37 million in the first quarter of 95/96, it added.
The Egyptian state sold off 60.75 percent of East Delta in late September. Its shares last traded on the Egyptian stock exchange on Monday at 53.50 pounds.
